name: found-power-decline-first-discard-still-offers-the-second
notes: Found Power: the first 'discard up to two' offer is declined, the second is used. Declining the first used to skip FoundPowerDiscard1, so the second offer never came.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. FoundPowerDiscard1 is queued by a generated body without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the first discard offer (PASS) skipped it and the second offer was never made. Fix: registered as decline-aware (GameCustomHandlerRunsOnPass).
